40021699.author: पदार्थः
40021699.content: तेषां of them, समुपविष्टानां who were seated, सर्वेषां of all, दीनचेतसाम् whose minds were distressed, काकुत्स्थो Kakutstha (Rama), परिशुष्यता drying up, मुखेन with his face, वाक्यं a word, उवाच spoke.

40021699.author: Translation
40021699.content: Rama, with a face parched by sorrow, spoke to all those who were seated before him with distressed minds.

40021700.author: पदार्थः
40021700.content: सर्वे all (of you), शृणुत listen, वः to you, भद्रं welfare (may there be), मनो mind, अन्यथा otherwise, मा do not, कुरुध्वं make, पौराणां of the citizens, मम my, सीतायां regarding Sita, यादृशी what kind of, कथा talk, वर्तते exists.

40021700.author: Translation
40021700.content: He asked them all to listen, wishing them well, and not to misunderstand, as he was about to reveal the kind of talk that existed among the citizens concerning his Sita.

40021701.author: पदार्थः
40021701.content: सुमहांस् very great, पौरापवादः scandal of the citizens, तथा and, जनपदस्य of the people of the country, च and, बीभत्सा disgusting (talk), मयि regarding me, वर्तते exists, सा that, मे my, मर्माणि vital parts, कृन्तति cuts.

40021701.author: Translation
40021701.content: A very great and abhorrent scandal from both the citizens and the people of the country exists concerning me, and that talk cuts into my very vitals.

40021702.author: पदार्थः
40021702.content: अहं I, किल indeed, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, इक्ष्वाकूणां of the Ikshvakus, कुले in the family, जात born, सीता Sita, अपि also, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, जनकानां of the Janakas, सत्कुले in a noble family, जाता born.

40021702.author: Translation
40021702.content: He stated that he was born in the family of the great-souled Ikshvakus, and Sita too was born in the noble family of the great-souled Janakas.

40021703.author: पदार्थः
40021703.content: सौम्य O gentle one, त्वं you, जानासि know, यथा how, दण्डके in Dandaka, विजने solitary, वने in the forest, सीता Sita, रावणेन by Ravana, हृता was abducted, च and, स he (Ravana), मया by me, विध्वंसितो was destroyed.

40021703.author: Translation
40021703.content: He reminded them, "O gentle one, you know how Sita was abducted by Ravana in the solitary Dandaka forest, and how I subsequently destroyed him."

40021704.author: पदार्थः
40021704.content: तत्र there, मे my, बुद्धिः thought, उत्पन्ना arose, जनकस्य of Janaka, सुताम् daughter, प्रति regarding, अत्र here, उषिताम् having resided, इमाम् this, सीताम् Sita, आनयेयम् I should bring, कथम् how, पुरीम् to the city.

40021704.author: Translation
40021704.content: At that time, a thought arose in my mind concerning Janaka's daughter, Sita, wondering how I could bring this Sita, who had resided here, back to the city.

40021705.author: पदार्थः
40021705.content: प्रत्ययार्थम् for the sake of proof, ततः then, सीता Sita, विवेश entered, ज्वलनम् fire, तदा then, प्रत्यक्षम् in the presence of, तव your, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, देवानाम् of the gods, हव्यवाहनः the fire-god, अपापाम् sinless, मैथिलीम् Maithili, आह declared, वायुः the wind-god, च and, आकाशगोचरः moving in the sky.

40021705.author: Translation
40021705.content: Then, for the sake of proof, Sita entered the fire, and in your presence, O Lakshmana, the fire-god and the wind-god, who moves in the sky, declared Maithili to be sinless.

40021706.author: पदार्थः
40021706.content: चन्द्रादित्यौ the moon and the sun, च and, शंसेते declared, सुराणाम् of the gods, सन्निधौ in the presence, पुरा formerly, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, च and, एव indeed, सर्वेषाम् of all, अपापाम् sinless, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter.

40021706.author: Translation
40021706.content: Furthermore, the moon and the sun, in the presence of all the gods and sages, formerly declared Janaka's daughter to be sinless.

40021707.author: पदार्थः
40021707.content: एवम् thus, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, देवगन्धर्वसन्निधौ in the presence of gods and Gandharvas, लङ्काद्वीपे on the island of Lanka, महेन्द्रेण by the great Indra, मम my, हस्ते in the hand, निवेशिता placed.

40021707.author: Translation
40021707.content: Thus, she of pure conduct was entrusted into my hands by the great Indra himself on the island of Lanka, in the presence of gods and Gandharvas.

40021708.author: पदार्थः
40021708.content: अन्तरात्मा my inner self, च and, मे my, वेत्ति knows, सीताम् Sita, शुद्धाम् pure, यशस्विनीम् glorious, ततः then, गृहीत्वा having taken, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, अहम् I, आगतः came.

40021708.author: Translation
40021708.content: And my inner self knows Sita to be pure and glorious, so thereafter, I brought Vaidehi to Ayodhya.

40021709.author: पदार्थः
40021709.content: अयं this, तु indeed, मे my, महान् great, वादः accusation, शोकः sorrow, च and, हृदि in the heart, वर्तते exists, पौरापवादः the slander of the citizens, सुमहान् very great, तथा and, जनपदस्य of the country, च also.

40021709.author: Translation
40021709.content: This great accusation and sorrow, which is the very great slander of the citizens and the people of the country, exists in my heart.

40021710.author: पदार्थः
40021710.content: अकीर्तिः infamy, यस्य whose, गीयेत is sung, लोके in the world, भूतस्य of a being, कस्यचित् any, पतति falls, एव indeed, अधमान् to lower, लोकान् worlds, यावत् as long as, शब्दः the word, प्रकीर्त्यते is proclaimed.

40021710.author: Translation
40021710.content: Any being whose infamy is spoken of in the world falls to lower realms as long as that word of disgrace is proclaimed.

40021711.author: पदार्थः
40021711.content: अकीर्तिः infamy, निन्द्यते is condemned, देवैः by the gods, कीर्तिः fame, लोकेषु in the worlds, पूज्यते is honored, कीर्त्यर्थम् for the sake of fame, तु indeed, समारम्भः the undertaking, सर्वेषाम् of all, सुमहात्मनाम् great-souled ones.

40021711.author: Translation
40021711.content: Infamy is condemned by the gods, while fame is honored in all worlds, and indeed, all great-souled individuals undertake their endeavors for the sake of renown.

40021712.author: पदार्थः
40021712.content: अपि even, अहम् I, जीवितम् life, जह्याम् would abandon, युष्मान् you, वा or, पुरुषर्षभाः O best among men, अपवादभयात् from the fear of slander, भीतः afraid, किम् what, पुनर् then, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter.

40021712.author: Translation
40021712.content: O best among men, I, being afraid of the fear of slander, would even abandon my life or you all, so what then of Janaka's daughter?

40021713.author: पदार्थः
40021713.content: तस्मात् therefore, भवन्तः you, पश्यन्तु may see, पतितम् fallen, शोकसागरे in the ocean of sorrow, न not, हि indeed, पश्याम्यहम् I see, भूतं existing, किञ्चित् any, दुःखम् sorrow, अतः than this, अधिकम् greater.

40021713.author: Translation
40021713.content: Therefore, you should see me fallen into an ocean of sorrow, for I indeed do not see any existing sorrow greater than this.

40021714.author: पदार्थः
40021714.content: श्वः tomorrow, त्वं you, प्रभाते in the morning, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, सुमन्त्राधिष्ठितं driven by Sumantra, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, सीताम् Sita, आरोप्य having made to ascend, विषयान्ते at the border of the kingdom, समुत्सृज abandon.

40021714.author: Translation
40021714.content: O Lakshmana, tomorrow morning, you must ascend the chariot driven by Sumantra, place Sita in it, and abandon her at the border of the kingdom.

40021715.author: पदार्थः
40021715.content: गङ्गायाः of Ganga, तु indeed, परे on the other, पारे bank, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, तु indeed, महात्मनः of the great soul, आश्रमः hermitage, दिव्यसङ्काशः divine-looking, तमसातीरम् the bank of Tamasa, आश्रितः situated.

40021715.author: Translation
40021715.content: On the other bank of the Ganga, there is the divine-looking hermitage of the great sage Valmiki, situated on the banks of the Tamasa river.

40021716.author: पदार्थः
40021716.content: तत्र there, एनां her, विजने solitary, देशे in the place, विसृज्य having abandoned, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu dynasty, शीघ्रम् quickly, आगच्छ come back, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, कुरुष्व do, वचनं command, मम my.

40021716.author: Translation
40021716.content: O Lakshmana, having abandoned her there in that solitary place, return quickly; may good fortune be yours, and carry out my command.

40021717.author: पदार्थः
40021717.content: न not, च and, अस्मिन् in this matter, प्रतिवक्तव्यः to be argued against, सीतां Sita, प्रति regarding, कथञ्चन in any way, तस्मात् therefore, त्वं you, गच्छ go, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, न not, अत्र here, कार्या to be done, विचारणा deliberation.

40021717.author: Translation
40021717.content: And regarding Sita, you must not argue against this command in any way; therefore, O Lakshmana, go, for no deliberation is to be done in this matter.

40021718.author: पदार्थः
40021718.content: अप्रीतिः displeasure, हि indeed, परा great, मह्यं to me, त्वया by you, एतत् this, प्रतिवारिते if opposed, शापिता sworn, हि indeed, मया by me, यूयं you all, भुजाभ्यां by my arms, जीवितेन by my life, च and.

40021718.author: Translation
40021718.content: Indeed, great displeasure will befall me if you oppose this, for I have made you all swear by my arms and by my very life.

40021719.author: पदार्थः
40021719.content: ये those who, मां me, वाक्यान्तरे with other words, ब्रूयुः would speak, अनुनेतुम् to persuade, कथञ्चन in any way, अहिताः enemies, नाम indeed, ते they, नित्यम् always, मदभीष्टविघातनात् because of obstructing my desire.

40021719.author: Translation
40021719.content: Those who would speak to me with other words, attempting to persuade me in any way, are indeed always my enemies because they obstruct my desire.

40021720.author: पदार्थः
40021720.content: मानयन्तु let them respect, भवन्तः you, मां me, यदि if, मच्छासने in my command, स्थिताः established, इतः from here, अद्य today, नीयताम् let her be taken, सीता Sita, कुरुष्व do, वचनम् the command, मम my.

40021720.author: Translation
40021720.content: If you abide by my command, then respect me; let Sita be taken from here today, and obey my word.

40021721.author: पदार्थः
40021721.content: पूर्वम् previously, उक्तः said, अहम् I, अनया by her, गङ्गातीरे on the bank of the Ganga, अहम् I, आश्रमान् hermitages, पश्येयम् may see, इति thus, तस्याः her, च and, कामः desire, संवर्त्यताम् let it be fulfilled, अयम् this.

40021721.author: Translation
40021721.content: She had previously told me that she wished to see the hermitages on the bank of the Ganga, so let this desire of hers be fulfilled.

40021722.author: पदार्थः
40021722.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, काकुत्स्थः Rama, बाष्पेण with tears, पिहिताननः having his face covered, प्रविवेश entered, सः he, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, भ्रातृभिः by his brothers, परिवारितः surrounded.

40021722.author: Translation
40021722.content: Having spoken thus, Rama, the righteous one, with his face covered in tears, entered, surrounded by his brothers.

40021723.author: पदार्थः
40021723.content: शोकसंलग्नहृदयः with a heart engulfed by sorrow, निशश्वास he sighed, यथा like, द्विपः an elephant.

40021723.author: Translation
40021723.content: With his heart engulfed by sorrow, he sighed like an elephant. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 45 ।। Thus ends the forty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
